effect_description_eng:
[Start of Your Main Phase] By placing 1 [BEATBREAK] trait card from your hand face down under this Tamer, ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck.) and gain 1 memory.
[All Turns] When any Digimon suspend, by suspending this Tamer, you may place the top card of your deck face down under this Tamer.
security_effect_description_eng: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
